_meta.description: Per-row influence of an OLS fit on customers.pulse (target=income, predictors=[age]): ATTR_REG_INFLUENCE's default Cook's distance and its params.measure dffits, beside ATTR_REG_RESIDUAL's params.kind studentized (R rstudent). Cook's distance combines a row's residual with its leverage — how far every fitted value would move if the row were left out; DFFITS is the move of the row's own fitted value in standard errors. The maxima point at the rows to inspect; the D > 1 and |DFFITS| > 2 sqrt(p/n) screens are rules of thumb, not tests. Unpenalized OLS only.
_meta.name: attr_reg_influence
